diff_articulation.what_changed: New active-order handoff for DO-103 Stage 3, queued DO-101B handoff, and crosswalk §11 sequencing table. REVIEW PASS 2026-08-19 (copyedit only, no authority change): DO-101B header corrected 'anisotropic-model reuse' -> 'orthotropic-model reuse' to match repo convention (wood is modelled orthotropic throughout - OrthotropicPlate in rayleigh_ritz.py, LUTHERIE_MATH.md sec.12 and its statement 'Real wood is orthotropic'; 'anisotropic' occurs in this repo only inside a cited book title). Activation-gate item 3 'FROZEN / COMPLETE' disambiguated to 'FROZEN or COMPLETE' because it is a gate condition where the slash is load-bearing. Acceptance criterion 5 grammar fixed ('boundary ... still hold' -> 'boundary ... still holds') and de-slashed. 'authorizes only' -> 'this authorization establishes only' so the record reads as recording authority rather than conferring it. Also: 'time-order sensitive' -> 'sequencing-critical'; 'left a physical acquisition path' -> 'came from a physical acquisition chain'; DO-101B title '...Discovery' -> '...Registry and Discovery' to match its own body (registry + schema + CLI + reuse); one 'Toolbox' -> 'ToolBox' casing fix (8:1 against); and a backlink from DO-101B to CROSS_REPO_AUTHORITY_CROSSWALK.md sec.11.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No prior DO-103/DO-101B authorization existed in-repo; this freezes sequencing before hardware campaign or registry schema work.
